description: Default git branching model. Projects override this in .ai-engineering/project.yaml under repository.branching; the hook reads the project value first and falls back to these defaults.
rules: Agents never commit or push directly to a protected branch.
Agents never force-push any branch they did not create in the current task.
History rewriting on a shared branch requires human approval (AP-09).
Every merge to a protected branch goes through a merge request with at least one approval from someone other than the author.

commit_convention.requirement: Every commit body carries at least one traceability identifier. See skills/traceability.
